stem: Which sentence from the selection best expresses the author’s opinion about the culture of high school?

options.label: F
options.text: Something happened to my exuberance as I approached high school. (paragraph 1)

options.label: G
options.text: It takes time to excavate a past, but it is well worth it. (paragraph 5)

options.label: H
options.text: You may not be able to change the voices you have believed any more than I can go back and rewrite my journal entries from high school. (paragraph 6)

options.label: J
options.text: It was toxic water to my spirit: I drank it in thinking it was life, but later came to find it was slowly killing me. (paragraph 9)
